issues.title: [Bug] A skipped-role notice between two replies merges them into one turn, hiding the earlier finished answer inside Activity

en.headline: One issue comment on openchamber; two automated commits in sogeisetsu
en.summary: On 2026-10-12, the user had no own commits, pull requests, reviews, or releases. The only activity was a comment on issue `#4664` in `openchamber/openchamber`, titled "[Bug] A skipped-role notice between two replies merges them into one turn, hiding the earlier finished answer inside Activity". Separately, `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` recorded **2 automated commits** by `github-actions[bot]`, with no own commits that day. No discussions were started or joined, no stars were added, and no state changes were reported.
